newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL key stocks support index's rise in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: KL key stocks support index's rise in slow trade.

text.p: Gains in a clutch of blue-chip stocks supported the key index's rise in an otherwise slow start to trading, dealers and analysts said.
Around 0305 GMT, the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's key Composite Index was up 7.21 points to 1,116.05. The broader Emas index was up 1.0 to 314.59.
"The market mood is not particularly bullish. A lot of the recent run up has been due to domestic funds," said a research director at a foreign brokerage.
